thread:
kiran: Starting canary rollout for app-service v3.2.0 -> 5% traffic. Deploybot watching p95 + error-rate. Leaving safety flag as 'manual' for dedicated pools.

deploy-bot: MONITOR: p95 +42% vs baseline (threshold 30%). Autorevert blocked by policy: safety=manual. Suggested action: manual rollback to v3.1.4.

noah: Do we see errors or just latency? any tail calls to external services?

maria: Mostly latency on embedder worker, traces show KV cache misses spiking. Error-rate steady.

kiran: OK. Decision: pause rollout and manual rollback for canary. @linda can you execute rollback and pin older version for Dedicated until we triage?

linda: On it. Running rollback command now.

linda: ```
redwood rollback --service app-service --from 3.2.0 --to 3.1.4 --scope canary --reason "canary p95 regression"
```

deploy-bot: ACTION: rollback job started (job-id: rb-1764104321-01). Expected completion ~90s. Will stream progress.

deploy-bot: UPDATE: rollback complete for canary slice. Traffic at previous baseline. Monitoring for 10m.

maria: Also pin v3.1.4 for Dedicated pools to avoid auto-promotion.

linda: Pinning now: ```
redwood pin-version --service app-service --version 3.1.4 --scope dedicated --until 2026-03-26 --note "hold after canary regression"
```

noah: I'll draft a short customer comms blurb for Dedicated accounts and add console banner. Suggested text: "We paused a recent canary rollout for app-service due to increased latency for a small percentage of requests. We've rolled back the canary and pinned the previous stable version while we investigate. No dedicated customer action required; we will follow up with root cause and ETA for re-release."

kiran: Perfect. @sre-oncall please open an incident and attach traces + perf diff. Tagging oncall infra and model-team.

sre-oncall: Created INC-2026-1234, added traces and perf graphs. Assigned to maria and infra.

maria: Will run regression evals against the canary prompt set and check quantization kernel selection logs. I'll update INC when we have a repro.

kiran: Thanks everyone. Post-rollback checklist: (1) customer comms (noah), (2) pin confirmed (linda), (3) incident + triage (maria/sre), (4) decide whether to hotfix or re-run canary with kernel tweak. We'll reconvene in 30m. :thumbsup:
